prompt: Add an isValidPageRequest(page: number, pageSize: number): boolean guard to src/common/validation.ts, alongside isEmail and assertRequired. It should return false when page < 1, or pageSize < 1, or pageSize > 100, and true otherwise. Export it.
rationale: Pure validation helper with a clear, checkable name and contract.

prompt: ProductsController.adjustPriceRoute casts req.body as never to satisfy the compiler. Add an AdjustPriceDto interface ({ newPriceCents: number }) near the top of products.controller.ts (or in a new dto file) and use it to type the route's body instead of the unsafe cast.
rationale: Removes an unsafe `as never` cast in favor of a real typed DTO.

prompt: WebhooksService.verifySignature is declared as an async method returning boolean (should be Promise<boolean>) and calls computeHmacSha256/timingSafeEqual, which don't exist anywhere in this codebase — it cannot possibly run. Implement it for real using Node's built-in crypto module: compute an HMAC-SHA256 of rawBody using the endpoint's secret, and compare it to signatureHeader using crypto.timingSafeEqual for a constant-time comparison. Fix the return type annotation to Promise<boolean>.
rationale: Implements a stubbed, fundamentally non-functional security method with a real, secure algorithm.

prompt: AuthService.hashPassword, generateAccessToken, and refreshAccessToken call bcryptHash/signJwt/verifyJwt, none of which exist anywhere in this codebase, and generateAccessToken is declared async but returns `string` instead of `Promise<string>`. Implement all three for real using only Node's built-in crypto module: hash passwords with a random salt (e.g. crypto.scryptSync), and issue/verify a simple HMAC-signed token embedding the user id and an expiry derived from ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS. Fix the return type annotation.
rationale: Implements broken/stubbed authentication primitives end-to-end with real, dependency-free crypto.

prompt: AdminService.impersonateUser and suspendAccount reference this.auditLogService, this.authService, and this.usersService, but none of them are declared as constructor-injected dependencies — only repository is. Add the three missing dependencies to the constructor (following the same `private readonly` pattern already used in this codebase, importing AuditLogService, AuthService, and UsersService from their respective modules) so these calls type-check and work at runtime.
rationale: Three real missing dependencies in one service (confirmed by tsc: three separate TS2339 errors).

prompt: CartService.checkoutCart references this.ordersService, which is never injected — only repository is. Also, mergeGuestCart calls this.repository.findById(guestCartId) and immediately accesses guestCart.items without checking whether the cart was found, so a missing guest cart throws a confusing TypeError. Inject an OrdersService dependency the same way repository is injected, and add a not-found check in mergeGuestCart that throws a clear error (e.g. `Cart ${guestCartId} not found`) before accessing .items.
rationale: Two distinct real bugs in one file: a missing dependency and an unchecked possibly-undefined value.

prompt: InventoryService.reserveStock and releaseStock call this.repository.incrementReserved(productId, quantity) and decrementReserved(productId, quantity), but InventoryRepository only implements the generic insert/findById/findAll/update/delete — these two methods don't exist. Implement both on InventoryRepository, following the existing in-memory Map style: look up the StockItem by productId (not id), and adjust its quantityReserved accordingly, clamping decrementReserved at 0.
rationale: Implements two genuinely missing repository methods that the service layer already depends on.

prompt: ReviewsService.flagReview and computeAverageRating call this.repository.incrementFlagCount(id, flaggedBy) and this.repository.averageRatingForProduct(productId), neither of which exist on ReviewsRepository. Add a flagCount?: number field to the Review interface, then implement both methods on ReviewsRepository following the existing in-memory Map style: incrementFlagCount bumps flagCount by 1 and returns the updated row, averageRatingForProduct computes the mean rating across rows matching productId (returning 0 if there are none).
rationale: Implements two genuinely missing repository methods plus the interface field they depend on.

prompt: AuditLogService.recordAuditEntry stores a recordedAt field that isn't declared on the AuditEntry interface (a real compile error), and purgeOldEntries calls this.repository.deleteOlderThan(olderThanDays), which doesn't exist on AuditLogRepository. Add recordedAt: string to the AuditEntry interface, then implement deleteOlderThan on AuditLogRepository following the existing in-memory Map style: delete and count every row whose recordedAt is older than olderThanDays days from now, returning the count deleted.
rationale: Fixes a real interface/field mismatch and implements a genuinely missing repository method together.

prompt: Add page and pageSize query support to the products list endpoint: ProductsController.findAll should accept optional page/pageSize, and ProductsService.list should apply them using the existing paginate() helper from src/common/pagination.ts. page defaults to 1 and pageSize defaults to 20 with a maximum of 100; throw a ValidationError (from src/common/errors.ts) for out-of-range values.
rationale: The flagship 'paginated REST endpoint with input validation' task, self-contained using existing helpers.

prompt: OrdersController.convertCartToOrderRoute and cancelOrderRoute both cast req.body as never. Add two typed DTOs in orders.controller.ts (or a new dto file): ConvertCartToOrderDto (empty marker interface is fine) and CancelOrderDto ({ reason: string }), and use them to type each route's body instead of the unsafe casts.
rationale: Two related unsafe casts cleaned up with proper request DTOs.

prompt: OrdersService.convertCartToOrder references this.cartRepository, but the constructor only injects this.repository (OrdersRepository) — there is no CartRepository dependency, so this method cannot work. Inject a CartRepository (import it from '../cart/cart.repository') the same way repository is injected, and use it consistently for the cart lookup and the clear() call.
rationale: A real missing-dependency bug (confirmed by tsc: 'cartRepository does not exist').

prompt: ProductsController.discontinueProductRoute calls this.productsService.discontinueProduct(id, req.body as never) with two arguments, but ProductsService.discontinueProduct only accepts a single id parameter, so the caller's intended reason is silently dropped. Update ProductsService.discontinueProduct to accept and store a second reason: string parameter, and update the controller call and its cast accordingly.
rationale: Real TS2554 arity-mismatch bug (confirmed by tsc) that silently drops caller data.

preconditions.value: discontinueProduct(req.params.id as string, req.body as never)

checks.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const s=fs.readFileSync('src/modules/products/products.service.ts','utf8'); const c=fs.readFileSync('src/modules/products/products.controller.ts','utf8'); if(!/discontinueProduct\s*\([^)]*reason/.test(s)) process.exit(1); if(!/reason/.test(c)) process.exit(1); if(/req\.body as never/.test(c) && /discontinueProduct\([^\n]*as never\)/.test(c)) process.exit(1);"
